meaning:
1) to flow, overflow, flood, float
1a) (Qal) to flood
1b) (Hiphil)
1b1) to cause to flow over
1b2) to cause to float

elsewhere.note: and what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued you, and…
The man of God asked, “Where did it fall?” He showed him the place. He cut down a stick, threw it in there, and made the iron float.
Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”
